sentences.text: The common blackbird is an omnivore that lives in forest and on the ground, active by day.
It has been recorded eating Hawthorn, Rowan, Elder and Guelder Rose.
English Ivy, Dogwood, Bird Cherry and Dog rose are also among the recorded food plants.
In Mainz-Bingen 6009 reports have been logged over ten years, with the peak time spanning the whole year.
